name: After § 23
title: REPORT on Parliament’s estimates of revenue and expenditure for the financial year 2026
part_text: 23b. Rejects the financing of the organisation and reception of visitors under the European Union Visitors Programme, condemning it as an institutional manipulation tactic aimed at promoting a biased and unilateral narrative in favour of supranational integration, at the expense of national sovereignty, democracy, and pluralism; strongly condemns the use of public funds to finance "opinion multipliers", a strategy that distorts public debate, artificially steers political discourse, and marginalises alternative perspectives; rejects the misuse of taxpayer money to sustain a system where only an ideologically driven vision of Europe is promoted; demands the immediate elimination of those funds, as they contradict the principles of neutrality, objectivity, and respect for democratic diversity;
